answer: Each paid work slot is one of 200 plots in a shared garden, and claiming one means crossing a bridge and burning a 50 POA deposit, destroyed, never refunded. A sybil minting 1,000 clones burns 50,000 POA to seize plots, yet each clone earns only 30 POA per epoch, so the attack loses money at once. An honest agent pays once, holds the plot 20 epochs, and earns about 600 POA. The oasis clones chase is a mirage of burned deposits.
